description: Gather context about the proposed PR

intent.goal: Capture and persist all human and LLM interaction inputs and outputs to per-session JSON log files in the .powdrr directory.
intent.problem: Human and LLM interactions are not currently persisted to a file, making it impossible to audit, replay, or analyze past interactions.
intent.reasoning: The system specification requires all human and LLM interactions to be captured (req-1) in JSON format (req-2) without blocking the interaction flow (req-3). The architecture defines interaction-log-entry as the core entity and logging-module as the implementation module. This PR implements the logging module, the log file writer, and the interaction capture hooks.

acceptance_criteria.description: A JSON log file is created in .powdrr/interaction-log.json after the first interaction.
Every human and LLM input and output is written to the log file.
The log file contains valid JSON entries.
Logging does not block or delay the interaction flow.

expected_tests.description: Verify that a log file is created in .powdrr/interaction-log.json after an interaction.
Verify that the log file content is valid JSON.
Verify that all human and LLM inputs and outputs appear in the log.
Verify that the .powdrr directory is created automatically if it does not exist.
Verify that new entries are appended to the log file without overwriting existing entries.

required_test_cases.description: The test must prove that a log file is created in .powdrr/interaction-log.json.
The test must prove that the log file contains valid JSON entries.
The test must prove that all human and LLM interactions are captured.

expected_outcomes.description: A .powdrr/interaction-log.json file exists after the first interaction.
Each log entry is valid JSON with input, output, and timestamp fields.
Interaction latency is not noticeably affected by logging.

non_goals.description: File rotation and size management are not part of this PR; they will be addressed in a follow-up.
Sensitive data redaction is not part of this PR; it will be addressed in a follow-up.
Binary data handling is not part of this PR; it will be addressed in a follow-up.

risks.description: Synchronous file I/O could block interactions; mitigated by using asynchronous I/O or a background queue (app-4).
The .powdrr directory may not be writable; mitigated by graceful error handling (req-4).
Concurrent interactions could cause interleaved writes; mitigated by using a queue or lock.
